description: Build and publish a site from a brand kit (format dropyour.kit-marque/v1, documented at https://dropyour.io/en/docs/brand-kit), and manage the sites this token created. Needs an account token with the "kit" scope (Agence or Organisation offer). action='publier' validates `kit`, builds the site and publishes it in project `projet` (an id you choose: lowercase letters, digits, dashes), with `cle_idempotence` (replayed with the same kit, the same answer comes back). A second kit for the same project publishes a NEW VERSION of the same app at the same address. Returns the address, the state and the warnings (adjusted contrast, stripped metadata, cleaned SVG, expired label hidden). action='etat' reads the project. action='suspendre' shows a "site paused" page (the site is kept, reversible); action='reprendre' puts it back (and cancels a scheduled withdrawal). action='proposer_transfert' emails a transfer link to the kit's contact_avis (never imposed). action='retirer' withdraws everything (all or nothing, safe to replay): with `motif` fin_de_contrat or effacement_demande, a notice goes to contact_avis and the deletion happens 10 days later; with motif renonciation, the confirmation goes first, then everything is deleted at once. action='gerer_a_la_main' with `actif` sets or clears the hand-managed flag: while set, a new kit is refused (409). This token reads no app data and touches no app it did not create.

cle_idempotence.description: For publier: 8 to 128 characters; replayed with the same kit, the same answer.

kit.description: The brand kit, for publier (format dropyour.kit-marque/v1).

projet.description: The project id, chosen by the emitter (one per business).
